jobs.title: 1st Vice President, Compliance (OFS)
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The 1st Vice President, Compliance for CIM is responsible for supporting the CCO of CIM and a CIM affiliate, OFS Management (“OFS”), in ensuring that OFS maintains a compliance program reasonably designed to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations. The 1st VP, Compliance is responsible for the day-to-day management of the OFS compliance program, including oversight of a team of two compliance professionals. The 1st VP, Compliance assists the CCO of OFS-managed registered investment companies in maintaining their compliance programs, including their 38a-1 manuals and reports to the relevant boards, with the expectation that the 1st VP, Compliance assumes the role of CCO of at least one of the investment companies. The 1st VP, Compliance is also committed to the highest ethical standards and constant reinforcement of CIM’s and OFS’ uncompromising culture of compliance.

jobs.title: Analyst, Loan Servicing
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Loan Servicing Analyst will provide key support to the Loan Servicing team, which oversees a portfolio of complex commercial bridge and construction loans. This role is essential to maintaining strong relationships with customers, borrowers, banks, and internal stakeholders. The position’s primary focus is executing analytical tasks, ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of loan management processes, and enhancing the quality and timeliness of service delivery.

jobs.title: Assistant Property Manager (Commercial)
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Assistant Property Manager supports effective administration of policies and procedures that promote well-managed, well-maintained buildings and grounds at company-owned commercial office properties to achieve maximum return on investment-grade, commercial real estate assets. The APM should be capable of managing the building staff/community in the absence of the Property Manager. The APM is responsible for assisting the Property Manager with the management of all on-site operations and achieving property financial and operational objectives.

jobs.title: Associate, Institutional Client Group
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: CIM Group is a private alternatives asset manager with 30-years of experience and approximately $32 billion in assets under management. Our expertise spans private equity and credit investments across real estate and infrastructure, offering a range of funds across the risk-return spectrum as well as customized client solutions. The Institutional Client Group (ICG) builds and maintains relationships with institutional investors and intermediaries globally. ICG includes regional institutional sales teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC—primarily serving pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and endowments—as well as the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), which serves major insurance companies and banks, and Global Consultant Relations (GCR), which works with investment consultants, OCIO providers, and other asset managers. ICG is seeking an Institutional Client Associate to join the Global Consultant Relations (GCR) team. This role works alongside senior team members, contributes to key fundraising initiatives, and offers direct exposure to some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors and intermediaries. As a visible member of a collaborative, high-performing team, the successful candidate will gain hands-on experience, develop critical skills, and build a strong foundation for a successful career at a respected and growing investment firm. This position is based at our headquarters in Los Angeles.

jobs.title: Associate, Investments (Infrastructure Focus)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

The work will directly contribute to, and be enabled by, the firm’s foundational data assets and policies.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist - ADA/PK/Biomarkers
jobs.description_text: Associate Scientists bring established laboratory experience and sound scientific judgment to study execution. In this role, you will perform assay work across development, validation, transfer, qualification, and sample analysis; organize and document scientific data; and address routine technical and operational issues. You will take ownership of assigned work while collaborating with Scientists, Senior Scientists, and project partners to keep studies accurate, compliant, and on schedule. Based on your experience, technical strengths, and the needs of the hiring team, your assignments may focus on sample analysis, assay development, method transfer or qualification, or a combination of laboratory projects.

The Project Setup Lead partners closely with Revenue, Accounts Receivable, Project Management, Business Development, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve exceptions, improve processes, maintain documentation, and drive operational excellence. This position is highly detail-oriented and requires strong organizational skills, contract review capabilities, process improvement experience, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment. Essential Responsibilities Serve as primary owner of project setup activities, ensuring projects are established accurately and timely within NetSuite and other applicable systems. Review contracts, statements of work, proposals, purchase orders, and other commercial documents to establish project and billing requirements. jobs.title: Scientist - ADA/PK
jobs.description_text: Scientist help turn well-executed laboratory work into dependable results for client studies. This role independently leads routine assay execution, applies sound technical judgment, reviews and interprets data, and works across laboratory operations, quality, and project teams to keep studies moving. You will work under general supervision, taking ownership of routine scientific activities while seeking guidance for novel or complex situations. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to study execution, scientific documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement in a collaborative laboratory environment. *Internal applications will be accepted until Monday, October 26th.

jobs.title: Scientist III - LC/MS (Bioanalytical)
jobs.description_text: In this hands-on, laboratory-based Scientist role, you will design, develop, and execute bioanalytical methods and experiments supporting the advancement of new therapies, with a particular focus on large-molecule LC/MS applications. You’ll spend much of your time at the bench performing method development, optimization, and GxP-compliant validation; generating and analyzing data; evaluating assay performance; and conducting targeted and untargeted analyses using liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through complex scientific problems, and seeing a method through from development to validation and execution. You’ll work across a variety of client programs and therapeutic areas, which means the science and day-to-day challenges can vary quite a bit. We’re looking for someone with strong LC/MS experience who is comfortable working in a regulated environment and understands the importance of producing accurate, high-quality data.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - ADA/PK/Biomarkers
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them.

jobs.title: Account Manager – Out-of-Home (OOH)
jobs.description_text: Role Summary & Impact As an Out-of-Home Manager, you will lead strategic OOH planning and buying across traditional and digital formats. You will manage campaigns from briefing through recommendation, negotiation, production, posting, measurement, and reconciliation, while serving as a key partner to clients, media owners, and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Develop OOH strategies based on client objectives, audiences, markets, locations, and the right mix of traditional and digital formats. Lead market research, inventory evaluation, RFPs, proposal analysis, and media-owner negotiations. Prepare clear recommendations, contracts, budgets, flowcharts, posting instructions, timelines, and creative specifications. Through engineering design you will support design management, design review, and value engineering. During construction you will review Subcontractor Submittals, RFIs, and NCRs. You will also provide regular site presence in support of QA/QC. Initially the jobsites are expected to be primarily in Texas, and periods of site presence will need to extend to multiple days at a time where you work closely with Energy Vault Construction Management teams. At project close-out you will be responsible for ensuring accurate as-built records and quality documents for Civil elements are produced and recorded. jobs.description_text: Role Summary We're seeking a senior electrical engineer to join our core engineering team and help us build lifesaving medical devices. You'll work daily with mechanical, acoustic, firmware, algorithm, and quality engineers, as well as our contract manufacturers and component vendors. You'll design the electronics that capture heart sounds, lung sounds, and ECG signals, power our devices, and send data wirelessly to our apps. The role covers both our shipping products and our next generation of hardware. On new products, you'll help define the hardware architecture and take designs from schematic through production. We encourage engineers to work outside their core discipline, and you're welcome to contribute to sensor, algorithm, and firmware development where you have the skills. This is a hands-on role with significant time spent in the lab. jobs.title: Construction Safety Engineer
jobs.description_text: CONSTRUCTION SAFETY ENGINEER As part of a team of technicians and engineers, you will provide technical expertise and assist in the implementation of all Environmental, Health and Safety programs at the McGregor, TX rocket-engine test site. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both environmental and occupational safety, is hands-on in a high-energy test environment, and can manage contractor and contingent-labor EHS with the same rigor as employee programs. We work as a highly integrated team and job responsibilities will include helping other programs to ensure the overall success of SpaceX. RESPONSIBILITIES: Work closely with test engineers, stand crews, and technician teams to perform detailed safety reviews of complex hazardous operations (hot fire, propellant loading, pressurization, ordnance, cryogenics, and post-test recovery) to ensure safe execution. Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures for Merlin, Raptor, fabrication, civil/construction, and support shops. jobs.title: Crane & Heavy Equipment Specialist (Starship)
jobs.description_text: CRANE AND HEAVY EQUIPMENT SPECIALIST (STARSHIP) The Crane and Heavy Equipment Specialist is a highly skilled and respected professional responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency of complex lifting and heavy equipment systems, including cranes, heavy lifting equipment, and related support systems. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The specialist is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. SpaceX doesn’t shut down production for maintenance, and instead, we find ways to predict failures and perform the maintenance without interrupting production. This role will require direct work with the engineers and technicians who design and build unique machines and perform risk analysis together to map out the maintenance strategy and find the best condition monitoring systems to monitor the performance. jobs.title: Critical Lift & Transport Engineer (Starship)
jobs.description_text: CRITICAL LIFT & TRANSPORT ENGINEER (STARSHIP) SpaceX is currently seeking an individual to join the launch site engineering team in Cape Canaveral, FL. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to utilize your multi-disciplinary knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions to launch pad operations, ground support equipment, transportation, and production with the goal of maximizing efficiency without sacrificing safety or reliability. Specifically, you will be responsible for ensuring all aspects of critical transport and lift operations for our Starship and Super Heavy booster vehicles, as well as ground support equipment, have been properly designed, reviewed, and carried out. You will be responsible for addressing complex structural, civil, and mechanical issues that arise and utilizing engineering intuition as well as thorough calculation to provide engineering disposition for the path forward. RESPONSIBILITIES: Plan, analyze, and execute critical lifts and heavy-haul transports for large-scale hardware (e.g., rocket stages, ground support equipment, or structural components), ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulations (e.g., OSHA, ASME B30), and engineering best practices. jobs.description_text: FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service.
